verses.original: Τούτου χάριν ἐγὼ Παῦλος ὁ δέσμιος τοῦ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν τῶν ἐθνῶν
verses.transliteration: Toutou charin egō Paulos ho desmios tou Christou Iēsou hyper hymōn tōn ethnōn
verses.literal: For this reason . . . I Paul the prisoner of Christ Jesus for the sake of you Gentiles

verses.original: Εἴ γε ἠκούσατε τὴν οἰκονομίαν τῆς χάριτος τοῦ Θεοῦ τῆς δοθείσης μοι εἰς ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: Ei ge ēkousate tēn oikonomian tēs charitos tou Theou tēs dotheisēs moi eis hymas
verses.literal: Surely you have heard about the stewardship of God’s grace that was given to me for you

verses.original: ὅτι κατὰ ἀποκάλυψιν ἐγνωρίσθη μοι τὸ μυστήριον καθὼς προέγραψα ἐν ὀλίγῳ
verses.transliteration: hoti kata apokalypsin egnōristhē moi to mystērion kathōs proegrapsa en oligō
verses.literal: that is the mystery made known to me by revelation as I have already written briefly

verses.original: πρὸς ὃ δύνασθε ἀναγινώσκοντες νοῆσαι τὴν σύνεσίν μου ἐν τῷ μυστηρίῳ τοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: pros ho dynasthe anaginōskontes noēsai tēn synesin mou en tō mystēriō tou Christou
verses.literal: In reading this, then you will be able to understand my insight into the mystery of Christ

verses.original: ὃ ἑτέραις γενεαῖς οὐκ ἐγνωρίσθη τοῖς υἱοῖς τῶν ἀνθρώπων ὡς νῦν ἀπεκαλύφθη τοῖς ἁγίοις ἀποστόλοις αὐτοῦ καὶ προφήταις ἐν Πνεύματι
verses.transliteration: ho heterais geneais ouk egnōristhē tois huiois tōn anthrōpōn hōs nyn apekalyphthē tois hagiois apostolois autou kai prophētais en Pneumati
verses.literal: which was not made known to men in other generations as it has now been revealed by the Spirit to God’s holy apostles and prophets

verses.original: εἶναι τὰ ἔθνη συνκληρονόμα καὶ σύσσωμα καὶ συμμέτοχα τῆς ἐπαγγελίας ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ διὰ τοῦ εὐαγγελίου
verses.transliteration: einai ta ethnē synklēronoma kai syssōma kai symmetocha tēs epangelias en Christō Iēsou dia tou euangeliou
verses.literal: This mystery is that through the gospel the Gentiles are fellow heirs fellow members of the body and fellow partakers of the promise in Christ Jesus

verses.original: οὗ ἐγενήθην διάκονος κατὰ τὴν δωρεὰν τῆς χάριτος τοῦ Θεοῦ τῆς δοθείσης μοι κατὰ τὴν ἐνέργειαν τῆς δυνάμεως αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: hou egenēthēn diakonos kata tēn dōrean tēs charitos tou Theou tēs dotheisēs moi kata tēn energeian tēs dynameōs autou
verses.literal: I became a servant of this gospel by the gift of God’s grace given me through the working of His power

verses.original: Ἐμοὶ τῷ ἐλαχιστοτέρῳ πάντων ἁγίων ἐδόθη ἡ χάρις αὕτη τοῖς ἔθνεσιν εὐαγγελίσασθαι τὸ ἀνεξιχνίαστον πλοῦτος τοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: Emoi tō elachistoterō pantōn hagiōn edothē hē charis hautē tois ethnesin euangelisasthai to anexichniaston ploutos tou Christou
verses.literal: Though I am less than the least of all the saints this grace was given me to preach to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ

verses.original: καὶ φωτίσαι πάντας τίς ἡ οἰκονομία τοῦ μυστηρίου τοῦ ἀποκεκρυμμένου ἀπὸ τῶν αἰώνων ἐν τῷ Θεῷ τῷ τὰ πάντα κτίσαντι
verses.transliteration: kai phōtisai pantas tis hē oikonomia tou mystēriou tou apokekrymmenou apo tōn aiōnōn en tō Theō tō ta panta ktisanti
verses.literal: and to illuminate for everyone the stewardship of this mystery which for ages past was kept hidden in God who created all things

verses.original: ἵνα γνωρισθῇ νῦν ταῖς ἀρχαῖς καὶ ταῖς ἐξουσίαις ἐν τοῖς ἐπουρανίοις διὰ τῆς ἐκκλησίας ἡ πολυποίκιλος σοφία τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: hina gnōristhē nyn tais archais kai tais exousiais en tois epouraniois dia tēs ekklēsias hē polypoikilos sophia tou Theou
verses.literal: His purpose was that now through the church the manifold wisdom of God should be made known to the rulers and authorities in the heavenly realms

verses.original: κατὰ πρόθεσιν τῶν αἰώνων ἣν ἐποίησεν ἐν τῷ Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ τῷ Κυρίῳ ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: kata prothesin tōn aiōnōn hēn epoiēsen en tō Christō Iēsou tō Kyriō hēmōn
verses.literal: according to the eternal purpose that He accomplished in Christ Jesus our Lord

verses.original: ἐν ᾧ ἔχομεν τὴν παρρησίαν καὶ προσαγωγὴν ἐν πεποιθήσει διὰ τῆς πίστεως αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: en hō echomen tēn parrēsian kai prosagōgēn en pepoithēsei dia tēs pisteōs autou
verses.literal: In Him and through faith in Him we may enter God’s presence with boldness and . . . confidence

verses.original: Διὸ αἰτοῦμαι μὴ ἐνκακεῖν ἐν ταῖς θλίψεσίν μου ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν ἥτις ἐστὶν δόξα ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: Dio aitoumai mē enkakein en tais thlipsesin mou hyper hymōn hētis estin doxa hymōn
verses.literal: So I ask you not to be discouraged because of my sufferings for you which are your glory

verses.original: Τούτου χάριν κάμπτω τὰ γόνατά μου πρὸς τὸν Πατέρα
verses.transliteration: Toutou charin kamptō ta gonata mou pros ton Patera
verses.literal: ... for this reason . . . I bow my knees before the Father

verses.original: ἐξ οὗ πᾶσα πατριὰ ἐν οὐρανοῖς καὶ ἐπὶ γῆς ὀνομάζεται
verses.transliteration: ex hou pasa patria en ouranois kai epi gēs onomazetai
verses.literal: from whom every family in heaven and on earth derives its name

verses.original: ἵνα δῷ ὑμῖν κατὰ τὸ πλοῦτος τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ δυνάμει κραταιωθῆναι διὰ τοῦ Πνεύματος αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸν ἔσω ἄνθρωπον
verses.transliteration: hina dō hymin kata to ploutos tēs doxēs autou dynamei krataiōthēnai dia tou Pneumatos autou eis ton esō anthrōpon
verses.literal: I ask that out of the riches of His glory He may strengthen you with power through His Spirit in your inner being

verses.original: κατοικῆσαι τὸν Χριστὸν διὰ τῆς πίστεως ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις ὑμῶν ἐν ἀγάπῃ ἐρριζωμένοι καὶ τεθεμελιωμένοι
verses.transliteration: katoikēsai ton Christon dia tēs pisteōs en tais kardiais hymōn en agapē errizōmenoi kai tethemeliōmenoi
verses.literal: so that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith Then you, being rooted and grounded in love

verses.original: ἵνα ἐξισχύσητε καταλαβέσθαι σὺν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἁγίοις τί τὸ πλάτος καὶ μῆκος καὶ ὕψος καὶ βάθος
verses.transliteration: hina exischysēte katalabesthai syn pasin tois hagiois ti to platos kai mēkos kai hypsos kai bathos
verses.literal: will have power together with all the saints to comprehend the length and width and height and depth

verses.original: γνῶναί τε τὴν ὑπερβάλλουσαν τῆς γνώσεως ἀγάπην τοῦ Χριστοῦ ἵνα πληρωθῆτε εἰς πᾶν τὸ πλήρωμα τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: gnōnai te tēn hyperballousan tēs gnōseōs agapēn tou Christou hina plērōthēte eis pan to plērōma tou Theou
verses.literal: of the love of Christ and to know this love that surpasses knowledge that you may be filled with all the fullness of God

verses.original: Τῷ δὲ δυναμένῳ ὑπὲρ πάντα ποιῆσαι ὑπερεκπερισσοῦ ὧν αἰτούμεθα ἢ νοοῦμεν κατὰ τὴν δύναμιν τὴν ἐνεργουμένην ἐν ἡμῖν
verses.transliteration: Tō de dynamenō hyper panta poiēsai hyperekperissou hōn aitoumetha ē nooumen kata tēn dynamin tēn energoumenēn en hēmin
verses.literal: Now to Him who is able to do immeasurably more than all we ask or imagine according to His power that is at work within us

verses.original: αὐτῷ ἡ δόξα ἐν τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ καὶ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ εἰς πάσας τὰς γενεὰς τοῦ αἰῶνος τῶν αἰώνων ἀμήν
verses.transliteration: autō hē doxa en tē ekklēsia kai en Christō Iēsou eis pasas tas geneas tou aiōnos tōn aiōnōn amēn
verses.literal: to Him be the glory in the church and in Christ Jesus throughout all generations forever . . . and ever Amen
